items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is officially active vs. Ravens after expected-to-play reports.
items.why: Confirmed active; prior reports of clean status with no docks.
items.implication: Start confidently as WR1; high target volume likely continues.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected, no injury docks.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow, listed as questionable (back), is officially active vs. the Texans and will start.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation after expected-to-play reports all week.
items.implication: Full go as fantasy QB1 even in tough matchup; no backup elevation impact.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status likely ~2:30pm ET. Would wear flak jacket. Team did not elevate a WR.
items.why: Improved more steadily than anticipated, practiced Friday limited, pushing to play per Rapoport/Schefter.
items.implication: Risky WR2/3 if active due to docks/flak; monitor inactives closely. Johnston/Harris upside if out.
items.opportunity: Primary target share if plays, but volume docks possible.

items.text: Weekend summary: McConkey GTD optimism+flak; Nacua GTD; Harvey not expected; Olave/Burrow/Black/McMillan (snap count) expected; Flowers/Pittman OUT. Levitan docks/beneficiaries noted.
items.why: Aggregated weekend reports for fantasy-relevant statuses.
items.implication: Core Sunday AM intelligence for lineup locks/pivots.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled out for Week 2. Multiple sources confirm.
items.implication: Sit; Schultz/Hutchinson/Boutte elevated for targets vs Bengals.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz low-end TE1 climb; secondary WRs flex.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) doubtful; could return next week. Elevated Myarick. Will test pregame.
items.why: Meniscus surgery recovery; improving but week-to-week.
items.implication: Likely sit this week; stash for next. Mayer elevated opportunity.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE upside if out.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) sounds like true game-time decision for MNF vs Giants; pre-game decision per Schefter. Different injury from camp psoas.
items.why: Won't practice second straight day; Rams consider pre-game decision. Backup Whittington doubtful.
items.implication: Have pivot ready (TEs Ferguson/Parkinson or Mumpfield/Fields); start if active but risky.
items.opportunity: If out, heavier TE usage and secondary WR bump.

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring), listed questionable, is unlikely to play vs Jaguars per source. ETR: not expected.
items.why: Hamstring injury; Schefter source + ETR summary.
items.implication: Sit; look to committee/backup for carries/targets.
items.opportunity: Decent look expected at Jonah Coleman (or other backs) in role expansion.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) downgraded to OUT. Opens door for Rashod Bateman; Mark Andrews saw 25% target share in W1 with Flowers/Lane banged up.
items.implication: Sit entirely; Bateman/Andrews elevated for targets.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Ravens pass-catchers including Andrews.

items.text: Steelers have downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT (foot). ETR/Levitan expect decent look at Germie Bernard; Berry agrees Bernard good fit.
items.why: Foot injury; DNP later in week, official downgrade.
items.implication: Sit; Wilson/Bernard/Freiermuth move up in rotation.
items.opportunity: YAC/role expansion for Bernard and slot options.

items.text: Bucs WR Jalen McMillan (knee) active/expected to play but not full-time role/snap count yet.
items.why: Expected but limited snaps per source; ETR notes snap count.
items.opportunity: Limited routes; other Bucs WRs may see more if restricted.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target rate tying team lead. IND just gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite utilization + soft matchup vs Indy run D.
items.implication: Strong RB1/2 start; high floor/ceiling from dual usage.

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization score (tied Bijan lead), 19% target share last 10 games, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Workhorse usage + pass-game involvement vs non-scary Chargers D.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util score, 26% target share, 100% RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Passing + RZ monopoly + soft run matchup.

items.text: LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1; 93 rec yds/18 PPG avg in 6 career games with Wentz. Soft Bears D vs WRs.
LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: Home smash (21.3 PPG last yr home), WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1. Top-5 implied total 27 in high-total game.
items.why: Home efficiency + soft secondary + shootout script.

items.text: HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, 69% fantasy pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes passing role; underdog script not run-friendly.
items.why: Reduced workload W1 + Kamara return creates committee squeeze.
items.implication: Fade/sit if better options; volatile RB3/flex.
items.opportunity: Snap/target share likely drops with Kamara.

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr. vs SEA: Only 8% target share W1 (5th on team), zero RZ looks. SEA allows 3rd-fewest fantasy PPG to WRs.
